publications.title: Network Function Virtualization: State-of-the-Art and Research Challenges

publications.title: Loss-Tolerant RDMA Network Over Commodity Devices
publications.research_problem: On lossy data-centre fabrics, RDMA suffers packet losses and repeated retransmission timeouts that degrade or interrupt service.
publications.approach: NüWa identifies the packets whose loss would trigger timeouts and protects them, with a switch mode for ordinary NICs and a NIC mode for programmable NICs.
publications.key_contribution: A loss-tolerant RDMA design for commodity hardware that avoids timeout-inducing packet losses.
publications.edge_relevance: Opportunistic and Delay-Tolerant Networks (Computer Networks and Communications)
